 In the Round Robin at the Nitto ATP Finals on Friday, Carlos Alcaraz (ranked No. 3) faces another top-10 player in Flavio Cobolli (No. 6).
 With -909 odds, Alcaraz is favored over Cobolli (+525) in this matchup.
 Nitto ATP Finals Info 
 Tournament: The Nitto ATP Finals
 Round: Round Robin
 Date: Friday, November 20
